description: Source code for managing permissions commands in Mattermost CLI, including add, remove, and reset permissions for roles.

methods.name: addPermissionsCmdF
methods.description: Adds specified permissions to a role, including ancillary permissions.

methods.name: removePermissionsCmdF
methods.description: Removes specified permissions from a role, ensuring ancillary permissions are handled correctly.

methods.name: resetPermissionsCmdF
methods.description: Resets a role's permissions to default values.
